summary: ICP (Internet Computer) full-stack starter app: Motoko backend with authorization/access-control, and a React/Tailwind (shadcn/ui) frontend implementing Internet Identity login, user profile setup, client-side encryption session, and basic encrypted calendar functionality (events and tasks) with query/mutation APIs and app shell layout.

existing_features.title: Motoko backend canister with authorization/access-control modules
existing_features.description: Backend includes reusable authorization mixin and access-control logic integrated into the main canister for authenticated operations.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication flow in frontend
existing_features.description: Frontend supports Internet Identity sign-in via dedicated hooks and login screen, wiring an authenticated actor for backend calls.

existing_features.title: User profile setup UI
existing_features.description: ProfileSetupModal and current-user profile hook to capture/display initial user profile details after authentication.

existing_features.title: Client-side encryption session with passphrase unlock
existing_features.description: Encryption session management using WebCrypto with a passphrase unlock modal and shared crypto types/utilities.

existing_features.title: Encrypted calendar codec and API layer
existing_features.description: Typed query/mutation API layer plus an encrypted calendar codec for encoding/decoding encrypted calendar data exchanged with the backend.

existing_features.title: Events feature UI (list/cards/forms)
existing_features.description: EventsView with EventCard and EventFormDialog to create/edit/display events.

existing_features.title: Tasks feature UI (list/cards/forms)
existing_features.description: TasksView with TaskCard and TaskFormDialog to create/edit/display tasks.

existing_features.title: Frontend application shell/layout and navigation
existing_features.description: Main app shell layout scaffolding with shared UI structure for authenticated views.

existing_features.title: Build/deploy template and project scaffolding for ICP + React
existing_features.description: Repository includes build-template assets, scripts (image pruning/resizing), frontend/backend canister YAMLs, and deployment helpers for ICP projects.

existing_features.title: Typed backend bindings for frontend
existing_features.description: Generated TypeScript bindings and actor setup to call the Motoko backend from the React frontend.

existing_features.title: Refine the authenticated loading flow so the UI never shows the Events/Tasks views (or their query-driven error states) until all prerequisites are satisfied: (1) Internet Identity is authenticated, (2) the backend actor is ready, (3) the user profile has been fetched (and profile setup completed if needed), and (4) the encryption session is unlocked. When these prerequisites are not yet satisfied, show a clear, non-destructive loading state (English text) instead of rendering query error alerts.

Adjust React Query behavior for events/tasks fetching so that, after a logout/login cycle (including logging back in as the same principal) and subsequent unlock, the events and tasks queries reliably refetch and render fresh decrypted data without requiring a manual page refresh or the user pressing “Retry”. This should be achieved by refining the query enable/refetch conditions and/or invalidation strategy tied to actor readiness and unlock state (without editing files in frontend immutablePaths).

new_feature_requests.summary: Refine/fix calendar data loading logic after re-sign-in (events/tasks fail to load after logout/login despite being saved)

architectural_notes: Frontend uses React + Vite + Tailwind + shadcn/ui component library for UI scaffolding.
Authentication uses Internet Identity; frontend creates an authenticated actor for canister calls.
Client-side encryption uses WebCrypto with a passphrase-gated encryption session; calendar data is encoded/decoded via an encrypted codec module.
API layer split into calendarQueries and calendarMutations for reads/writes against the backend.
Backend written in Motoko with modular authorization/access-control (MixinAuthorization + access-control).
Project includes a reusable build-template with Dockerfile, canister YAMLs, and deploy scripts.
Build-template updated/expanded to include full shadcn/ui component scaffolding plus frontend lint rules enforcing ICP/Internet Identity best practices.

Backend authorization/access-control modules and migration logic were revised (component:authorization v4.0.0), implying updated internal APIs/structure while preserving the same overall authorization feature scope.
Data persistence + reload path after authentication/unlock must correctly fetch, decrypt, and decode events/tasks; handle missing/invalid encryption session and actor/auth state during initial load.
known_issues: After logout/login, events/tasks sometimes fail to load ("fail to load task" / "fail to load events") even when previously saved.
projectName: Refine calendar loading logic across auth/actor/unlock transitions
